reviews.author: Eliona T.
reviews.title: Don’t buy It!
reviews.body: Unfortunately my experience was extremely disappointing. I followed all the instructions carefully and started the process in the evening after properly cleansing my face. One of the first issues I noticed was with the silicone shields (the plastic pads you place on your eyelids). They did not stick properly at all and kept moving during the application, making the whole process uncomfortable and difficult. They also look completely different from what is advertised on their website and Instagram, which was misleading. Despite trying my best to proceed, the results were very concerning. The next morning, I woke up with a swollen, red eye that remained irritated for two days. On top of that, my eyelashes were completely damaged — they are not lifted or curled as promised, but instead look burned, uneven, and unhealthy. The overall result is far from what was advertised. I’m extremely disappointed because I followed every step as instructed, yet ended up with irritated eyes and ruined lashes. It feels like a complete waste of money, and I’ve been dealing with the aftermath for over two weeks now. I would not recommend this product based on my experience.

reviews.author: Monica A.
reviews.title: DO NOT BUY!
reviews.body: I rarely leave reviews, but I feel like I have to warn others about this lash lifting kit. The first time I used it, I followed the instructions carefully and even did a patch test on the back of my hand the day before, which was absolutely fine. However, after using it on my lashes, my eyes became extremely red, swollen, and unbearably itchy. It got so bad that I had to go to A&E for treatment. Once the swelling finally went down, I was left with eyelashes that were completely ruined. They looked burnt — dry, brittle, and sticking out in all directions. It was honestly embarrassing. I waited around 8 weeks before trying again (mainly because I felt insecure about how bad my lashes looked after the first time). At first, they seemed okay, but then the exact same thing happened — they became dry, damaged, and lifeless even after oiling every morning and night. Now, about 4 weeks later, my lashes have started falling out. Before using this kit, I had naturally long, healthy lashes. Now they’re sparse, brittle, and actually uncomfortable — my eyes feel irritated every time I blink because of how dry and jagged my lashes have become. I originally bought this on a buy-one-get-one-free deal, but I’ve thrown away both the used kit and the unopened one because I wouldn’t risk this happening again. My lashes are completely ruined. Please do not buy this product.

reviews.body: I had a lifting in a salon before and was not so enthusiastic about the rather weak result and it was also very expensive. That's why I wanted to try it out myself and I'm thrilled. I did both eyes at the same time and only applied the product from the area where the pad is. You're supposed to put a foil on while it's working - but I left it off when I fixed it. Everything is on the instructions. Between phase 1 and 2, a few lashes came off the pad, which was also mentioned in the instructions. Just be patient and apply a little glue to the pad if necessary, wait a short while and then reapply the rest of the lashes. The result was achieved with the enclosed pad size "M1" and speaks for itself.
